notes:
ACCESS: direct curl_cffi fetch via probe.py, HTTP 200 on every request across safari15_5/safari17_0/chrome120/chrome124/edge101/firefox133; no WAF, no proxy, no reader service, matching the Furniture-pass ledger note. robots.txt was fetched FIRST (https://www.rowenandwren.co.uk/robots.txt, 5,510 bytes, standard Shopify file). It declares SIX groups - '*', 'adsbot-google', 'Nutch', 'AhrefsBot', 'AhrefsSiteAudit', 'MJ12bot', 'Pinterest' - and names NO anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude agent and no Content-Signal line anywhere in the file. The '*' group disallows /search, /cart, /checkout, /account, /policies/ and every /collections/*sort_by* / *+* / *filter*&*filter* facet permutation; no recorded URL touches any of those (all four recorded/reviewed URLs are bare /collections/ paths and the only API I used, /collections.json and /collections//products.json, is not disallowed). No Crawl-delay applies to '*'; probe.py's 2s per-host gap was honoured throughout anyway. TREE: taken verbatim from the rendered mega-menu in the homepage HTML - the department list data-nav-column-toggle="main-menu-2025," gives 10 departments (New & Featured, Garden, Furniture, Accessories, Kitchen & Dining, Bedroom, BATHROOM, Hardware, Lighting, Last Chance). The Bathroom column (
    ) contains exactly five links: All (/collections/all-bathroom), Bathroom Fittings, Bathroom Mirrors, Bathroom Accessories, Bathroom Textiles. There is NO level 3: data-nav-column-level maxes out at 2, and I diffed the /collections/ hrefs on /collections/bathroom, /bathroom-fittings, /bathroom-mirrors and /bathroom-accessories against the homepage set - all four pages carry exactly the same 75 global-nav collection links and zero extras, so no leaf hides children. UNIVERSE CHECK: I also enumerated the store's entire collection list at /collections.json?limit=250 (161 collections, single page, exhausted) and grepped every handle+title for bath|shower|toilet|vanity|basin|sink|towel|soap|faucet|tap|wc|sanitary|mirror. The only hits were all-bathroom, bathroom, bathroom-accessories, bathroom-fittings, bathroom-lighting, bathroom-mirrors, bathroom-textiles, our-bathroom-collection and mirrors - i.e. the nav is complete and nothing bathroom-related is hidden from it except the two non-nav collections dealt with below. QTY: the listing page's own rendered header, literally N products in the served HTML (this theme renders the total server-side for these collections, not via Klevu). VERIFICATION: (a) EQUIVALENCE - I independently enumerated /collections//products.json?limit=250 paged to exhaustion and counted unique product ids: bathroom-fittings 30, bathroom-mirrors 14, bathroom-accessories 28, bathroom-textiles 7, bathroom-lighting 0, all-bathroom 67, mirrors 23, our-bathroom-collection 41 - identical to the rendered header in all 8 cases, on collections of eight different sizes. (b) NOT the Shopify inflation trap: /collections.json products_count reports 30/15/33/7/2/76/26/46 for the same handles, i.e. it over-counts (unavailable or unpublished items) on 5 of 8; the rendered header + products.json enumeration agree with each other and were used, products_count was NOT used. (c) DRIFT - all four bathroom leaves were re-fetched later on different impersonation profiles and every count reproduced exactly (30/14/28/7). (d) H1 + CANONICAL - each page's

    matched the node requested (Bathroom Fittings / Bathroom Mirrors / Bathroom Accessories) and each is self-canonical. (e) DISCRIMINATION - 30, 14, 28, 7, 0, 67, 23, 41: no site-wide constant. CONTENT CHECK (rule 2, primary product type): Bathroom Fittings = Wilbur/Bilton towel rails, double towel rails, towel rings, towel racks, toilet roll holders, shower caddies, shower shelves, bathroom shelves (rules 13/17). Bathroom Accessories = soap pumps, soap dishes, toothbrush holders, toilet brush holders, bathroom bins, bath caddies, trays, shower caddies, pedestal mirrors (rules 13/14/21) - it also carries the 7 textile items, but the node's primary type is accessories/hardware so it stays in Bathroom and the textile-only node is routed out instead. Bathroom Mirrors = Bilton Bathroom Mirror, Bilton Pedestal Mirror, Aster arched/rectangular, Indar hanging (rules 10/11 - mirrors, not luminaires). EXCLUDED - parent (rule 24): /collections/bathroom is a pure landing page (h1 'Bathroom', editorial copy + imagery, ZERO /products/ cards, no product-list.total element at all) and has three valid recorded children, so it is the top grouping row with blank qty/URL per rules 24/38. EXCLUDED - View All (rule 25): /collections/all-bathroom, 'All Bathroom', 67 products - the column's 'All' link. EXCLUDED - curated/editorial collection (rule 25): /collections/our-bathroom-collection, h1 'Daily Ablutions', 41 products - a promotional edit, not a category node, and not present in the Bathroom nav column. EXCLUDED - other departments: Accessories > Mirrors (/collections/mirrors, 23) is the general decorative-mirror node - Moray Twisted Oak overmantle, Oliver Oak oval/full-length, Balcombe Full Length, Elodie Dressing Table, Portloe Oak - and although 13 of the 14 bathroom mirrors are cross-listed into it, its own parent is Accessories and its primary content is decorative/dressing mirrors, so it belongs to its own category (rule 2, hierarchy over keyword). Hardware > Hooks & Rails (/collections/hooks-rails, 9) is Hardware-owned (Bitra Hook Rail, Grove Hanging Rails, Brana Wall Hook, Grove S Hooks) with only the 3 Wilbur towel rails already counted inside Bathroom Fittings; recording it would double-count, so it is left to Hardware (rules 28/30-33). CONFIRMED ABSENT: Rowen & Wren sells NO bathroom fixtures or sanitaryware. Across the full 161-collection universe and the whole mega-menu there is no Baths/Bathtubs, Basins/Sinks, Toilets/WCs, Bidets, Showers or shower systems, Shower Enclosures/Screens/Doors, Bathroom Taps/Faucets/Mixers or Vanity Unit node at any depth - it is a homeware brand, not a plumbing merchant. Consistent with the Furniture-pass ledger, which recorded that the Bathroom department has no furniture node (the single bathroom-adjacent furniture item, Hadlow Oak Cabinet, is merchandised inside Bathroom Fittings/Accessories/Mirrors rather than in a node of its own). CROSS-FILE DEDUP: lib/dedup.already_extracted() was run on all 10 candidate URLs (bathroom, all-bathroom, bathroom-fittings, bathroom-mirrors, bathroom-accessories, bathroom-textiles, bathroom-lighting, mirrors, hooks-rails, our-bathroom-collection). ZERO hits - the Furniture pass took only /collections/sofas, armchairs, tables, chairs-benches, storage-shelving, footstools, beds, garden-* , dining-furniture and bedroom-furniture, none of which is a bathroom node. Nothing removed for dedup.

review.issue: ROUTED TO TEXTILE: fourth child of the Bathroom mega-menu column, but every one of its 7 products is a textile - Ticking Stripe Shower Curtain, Heritage Cotton Bath Towel, Heritage Cotton Hand Towel and four Nella Handwoven Bath Mats (rules 15/16/20). No rubber/anti-slip bathroom-accessory mat exists, so rule 16's second limb does not apply. Not duplicated into Bathroom; the 7 items also appear inside Bathroom Accessories (28), whose own primary type is accessories/hardware, so that node stays in Bathroom.

ROUTED TO LIGHTING: /collections/bathroom-lighting exists in the store's collection list (title 'Bathroom Lighting') but is NOT linked from the Bathroom column, the Lighting column or any other nav node, and its rendered header reads '0 products' (products.json enumerates 0). Recorded so it is not silently skipped; primary product type would be lighting (rule 19) in any case.
